headline: With ‘Seven Guitars,’ Ruben Santiago-Hudson Keeps the Light on for August Wilson
context: Ruben Santiago-Hudson, a recent Tony nominee for “Joe Turner’s Come and Gone,” returns to the director’s chair for this season’s revival of “Seven Guitars.”
